description: This file is a shell script used for testing 'safe.bareRepository' functionality in Git. It defines tests to verify whether certain Git configurations related to bare repositories are correctly accepted or rejected, and sets up test repositories for these purposes.

methods.name: expect_accepted_implicit
methods.description: Checks whether Git accepts an implicit bare repository without errors and verifies related performance tracing logs.

methods.name: expect_accepted_explicit
methods.description: Checks whether Git accepts an explicitly specified GIT_DIR as a bare repository and verifies performance tracing logs.

methods.name: expect_rejected
methods.description: Verifies that Git rejects a repository when 'safe.bareRepository' is set to an explicit setting and records appropriate error messages.
